title: Deduplicate the quest-bridge orchestration shared by MCP, CLI, and UI
body:
The preview -> prepare -> init child -> commit -> foldback quest-launch sequence is implemented three times (src/mcp/overworld_quest_bridge.ts + tools.ts; src/cli/embedded_quest_journey.ts beginQuest; ui/src/App.tsx startQuest via GameSession), plus a fourth mostly-dead loop (bin/overworld_play.ts runQuestSession, kept alive only by wolf_winter_cli_command_projection.test.ts). This structure already produced a real divergence: the delayed-dispatch launch overlay existed only on the MCP path until audit/fix-2026-08-30 (which added a shared derivation in src/world/embedded_launch_overlay.ts and a parity regression, tests/regression/embedded_launch_overlay_parity.test.ts).

Remaining work: extract ONE shared launch/foldback sequencer all three interfaces call (the overlay derivation shows the pattern); extend the plan WeakMap authentication (assertAuthenticatedQuestStartPreparation, src/world/session.ts:482-490) beyond the MCP bridge — CLI and UI commit unauthenticated plans today; and retire runQuestSession by porting its one test to CliJourneySession.

From the 2026-08-30 full audit, findings ledger P2 (root cause of the launch-overlay P1).

evidence.summary: 2026-08-30 audit: triplicated bridge produced a real P1 divergence
